meta.title: Official-only correlations - computed from the 2026-11-18 standings capture
meta.method: Pearson r on club-level season totals taken from the NFL's own standings table; 95 % interval by Fisher's z transform (NIST Dataplot reference). No third-party or nflverse number enters any coefficient.
meta.sample: 2026 regular season through Week 10, one observation per club

rows.interpretation: Does the league table reward net points, i.e. is net points a usable team-strength signal?
rows.input: official 2026 standings rows read 2026-11-18 (points columns only where printed)
rows.excluded_note: 8 clubs (NFC South, NFC West) are excluded because the points columns were not read at this capture; the register is n=24, not n=32, and is labelled accordingly rather than padded.
